verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents custom templates that capture a machine and its configuration and can be used to create new machines with your specifications. Machine creation lets you pick an OS or a custom template, and Deployments run container images as containers-as-a-service. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bringing your own Docker image (registry or custom image support) for machines and notebooks, step-by-step template-creation depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run my own Docker image or custom machine template with my exact environment

citations.quote: Custom templates are templates of your machines and their configurations. You can use these custom templates to create new machines with your specifications.
When you create a new machine, you choose your machine type, operating system or custom template
Deployments are containers-as-a-service that let you run container images and serve machine learning models.
